fields.statement: Verifier in a detached checkout at e91bc0f3e re-ran the Checks block: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api/ -run Request (exit 0; -v shows TestRequestNoteAdd PASS), go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/describe-golden$' with -update then without (both exit 0, golden unchanged), rhiza ship generate and rhiza render (exit 0, tree clean). TestRequestNoteAdd queues with one --note, adds a second via request.note, request ls shows both in order, a 6-char prefix resolves, --dry-run writes nothing, and drawn (Run set), unknown, ambiguous, short-prefix, empty and non-UTF-8 notes are usage errors with requests.json byte-identical. Diff writes only through daemon.UpdateRequests (dry run reads only), refuses Run!="" per request-note-while-queued, leaves rhiza request's flags unchanged, no TODOs. Smoke test of a scratch build: note by prefix, --dry-run, abc and blank note refused with exit 2.
